newsitem.title: INDIA: India 1996/97 oilseed crop seen at 21.26 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: India 1996/97 oilseed crop seen at 21.26 mln tns.

text.p: India's 1996/97 (November-October) oilseeds crop has been estimated at 21.26 million tonnes, up from 20.98 million in the previous season, an official of the Central Organisation of Oil Industry and Trade (COOIT) said on Sunday.
The official told a COOIT seminar on oilseeds in the northern city of Agra that the 1996/97 summer crop was estimated at 9.35 million tonnes, down from 9.55 million in the previous year.
India harvests two oilseeds crops annually, with the bulk of its output coming from the winter crop. The winter crop is sown in July and harvested from October.
The COOIT official said the 1996/97 groundnut crop was estimated at 7.67 million tonnes against 6.63 million in the previous season.

India's oilseeds production swelled to around 22 million tonnes in 1993/94 from 11.68 million tonnes in 1986/87 as the cultivation area grew to 26 million hectares (64 million acres) from 19 million hectares (47 million acres).
Since then the output has been stagnant.
